title: AccessEval: Benchmarking Disability Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Paired evaluation comparing model responses to Neutral Queries (NQ) versus Disability-Aware Queries (DQ) across 6 domains and 9 disability types using sentiment analysis (VADER), social perception (Regard Score), and response quality assessment (LLM Judge) to measure degradation in tone, stereotyping, and factual accuracy.
